newsitem.title: INDIA: India VSNL to begin GDR roadshows Mar 10.
newsitem.headline: India VSNL to begin GDR roadshows Mar 10.

text.p: Indian telecommunications firm Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd (VSNL), is likely to begin roadshows for its long-awaited GDR issue on March 10, investment banking sources close to the deal said on Saturday.
An investment banker told Reuters the issue would be priced by the end of March.
"The pricing is likely to be before the long Easter weekend at the end of March," he said.

The banker, who did not want to be identified, said the company would begin a premarketing exercise from Monday. The company will be visiting major financial centres to talk to larger investors, he added.
Market sources have earlier estimated that the size of the issue, the third launch attempt in two years after two unsuccesful attempts in 1994, will be around $600 million.
Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, Jardine Fleming and Salomon Brothers are global coordinators to the issue.

Cazenove & Co, HSBC James Capel, Merrill Lynch, and Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) are the co-lead managers. BZW, CS First Boston, ING Barings, Lehman Brothers, Morgan Stanley and Peregrine are co-managers.
SBI Capital Markets is the domestic advisor to the company for the issue.
